LOGIC ADVENTURE 2 · CLASS 30

Robot’s Rainbow Logic

Age 4–5 YearsClass 30 · LogicSkill Pattern completion

Red, blue, red, blue… what comes next? Finish three of Robot’s picture patterns.

Play the puzzle game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · PATTERN COMPLETION

Robot’s Rainbow Logic

Look at each pattern and tap what comes next!

Red circle, blue circle, red circle, blue circle… what comes next?

Yellow star, green heart, yellow star, green heart… what comes next?

Small robot, big robot, small robot, big robot… what comes next?

Pattern pro!

Three patterns finished — Robot is dazzled.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

Pattern rows teach the reading-readiness skill of predicting what comes next. Say the pattern aloud together — "red, blue, red, blue…" — and let the rhythm point to the answer.

Prefer paper? The Robot’s Rainbow Logic worksheet prints the same puzzle with room to draw, sort and circle — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
